column1: # Section file renames, 2026-09-19 (D-464). The filename carries the
# file's POSITION again, so byte-order sorting over the paths
# reproduces reading order. A chapter's slot is the number it would
# print if \appendix had not reset the counter -- the convention the
# two \unnumberedlabel pins already use: Foreword 00, appendix 17,
# glossary 18. A continuation carries the stem of the file it
